result.summary: The page is generally well composed. The only visible defect is a small text overflow in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promo banner subtitle runs too far to the right: the trailing "€10" is cramped against/partly clipped by the banner edge.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the subtitle to the available banner width, reduce its font size, or wrap/truncate the text so the minimum-order amount has adequate right padding.
